resolutionWithoutFieldMap.finding: The unresolved sets are IDENTICAL under both header spellings. These are therefore genuine gaps in the adapter's candidate lists, not spelling mismatches, and normalising case would not have fixed them.

resolutionWithFieldMap.outcome: All four material gaps close. Zero ambiguous matches before or after.

C2.detail: bay spaceCount and bayLengthM do not resolve: the real columns are 'parking_spaces' and 'parking_bay_length_metres', and neither 'parking spaces' nor 'parking bay length metres' appears in BAY_FIELD_CANDIDATES. Both are OPTIONAL fields, so the adapter does not raise - it silently loads every bay with spaceCount=None, indexes zero streets, and fails F3 for a reason that has nothing to do with Camden. Exactly the failure C2 predicted, now observed rather than inferred.

C5.title: The publisher's own authoritative contravention description is discarded
C5.evidence: 4k7m-4gkk has a column 'contravention_code_description' carrying the official text verbatim (observed: 'Parked without payment of the parking charge' for code 11, 'Parked after the expiry of paid for time' for code 05, 'Parked in a restricted street during prescribed hours' for code 01). PCN_FIELD_CANDIDATES for contraventionDescription are ('contravention description','contravention','description','offence description','reason') - 'contravention code description' is not among them, so the field resolves to nothing and the column lands in unconsumedSourceFields.
C5.consequence: The description column would be empty for every row. C4A means classification no longer depends on it - class comes from the base-code lookup - so the verdict is not affected. But the record would lose the publisher's own wording, which is the best available cross-check on the artifact and the field a human reads to audit a row.
C5.freezeImpact: NONE. Column wiring only, which the freeze protocol explicitly permits.

C6.title: The CPZ join key does not resolve on the PCN side - would silently destroy the primary join level
C6.severity: SEVERE - this is the one that would have invalidated the run
C6.evidence: The bay dataset carries 'controlled_parking_zone' and resolves to cpz correctly. The PCN dataset carries 'controlled_parking_zone_area' - a DIFFERENT column name - and PCN_FIELD_CANDIDATES for cpz are ('cpz','controlled parking zone','zone','cpz code'), so it does NOT resolve. Observed values are compatible across the two datasets (CA-E, CA-B, CA-D, CA-F, CA-P, CA-M, CA-J, CA-Q, CA-H), so the join itself is sound; only the wiring fails.
C6.consequence: Every PCN would normalise with cpz=None. The pre-registration identifies CPZ as THE reliable join level because Camden street strings are uppercase with postcode suffixes and junction qualifiers, and protocol step 8 is 'run CPZ-level first'. With cpz unresolved the CPZ run would either fail coverage or - worse - join nothing to nothing and report a result about an empty intersection. cpz is not a REQUIRED field, so nothing would raise.

deliberatelyLeftUnresolved.wkt: Bay geometry. Mapping epsg_27700_well_known_text_geometry would pull polyline geometry into the bay records. The design forbids a bay-level join - Camden bay coordinates are an arbitrary node on a polyline and individual spaces are not identifiable - and assert_no_bay_level_join() guards it. Leaving it unresolved is the conservative choice and removes the temptation.
deliberatelyLeftUnresolved.pcnReference: The only candidate column is 'socrata_id', a Socrata internal row identifier. Mapping it as a PCN reference would assert provenance the publisher does not claim. This dataset appears to carry no PCN number at all.
deliberatelyLeftUnresolved.parkingRestriction: Genuinely absent from the PCN dataset - restriction type is a bay attribute. Correctly unresolved; not a defect.

verifiedPreviouslyUnverifiedItems.spatialAccuracy: NOW CONFIRMED PRESENT in 4k7m-4gkk as column 'spatial_accuracy', and it RESOLVES to the adapter's spatialAccuracy field without any override. At freeze time this was listed as documented-but-unverified because the metadata fetch failed on positions 31+. Observed value 'Unknown' on the sampled rows, which maps to the UNKNOWN_OTHER stratum. The bay dataset also carries 'spatial_accuracy' with observed value 'Defined By Custodian' - a value the strata model does not define, so it will surface as UNRECOGNISED rather than be absorbed, which is the designed behaviour.
verifiedPreviouslyUnverifiedItems.contraventionCodeSuffix: The publisher ALREADY splits base code from suffix: 'contravention_code':'52M' alongside 'contravention_code_suffix':'M'. This independently corroborates C4A's parsing design from the publisher's own schema.
verifiedPreviouslyUnverifiedItems.cctvMarker: A column 'ticket_issued_via_cctv_camera' (observed 'Yes'/'No') exists separately from spatial_accuracy, giving a second authoritative deployment indicator. Like suffix 'j' it is recorded and NOT used in any verdict.
verifiedPreviouslyUnverifiedItems.timestampGranularity: 'contravention_date' carries a full timestamp with milliseconds (observed '2026-05-15T15:22:00.000'), so hour is genuinely available and the no-hour-imputation rule is satisfiable rather than merely aspirational.

publisherDescriptionCorroboration.finding: Every observed publisher description matches the frozen artifact - exactly for codes 11, 05 and 01, and as artifact-text plus the suffix expansion in parentheses for 52M ('...certain types of vehicle (no motor vehicles)', where the artifact's suffix legend gives m = 'motor vehicles'). This independently corroborates the artifact transcription from a second source that was not used to build it.

publisherDescriptionCorroboration.caution: 'charging_band_description' is NOT a proxy for the source's 'Diff. level'. They agree for parking codes (11 Lower/Lower, 05 Lower/Lower, 01 Higher/Higher) but diverge for moving traffic: London Councils marks code 52 as 'n/a' while Camden charges 'Band A (Higher)'. Camden must assign a charging band even where the differential level is n/a. Using charging_band as a parking-vs-moving-traffic discriminator would therefore be wrong.

blocker.issue: The full downloads cannot be obtained from this sandbox.
blocker.detail: bash has no outbound network (curl to opendata.camden.gov.uk fails with SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL). The only network path is fetch_page, which returns content into the conversation rather than writing a file, so a 495,814-row PCN export cannot be materialised on disk by any number of calls. The SODA .csv endpoints additionally returned HTTP 500; only the .json endpoints responded.
blocker.requiredAction: Place both full exports in sources/camden/downloads/ - a path already gitignored, so the large data stays out of Git. Either spelling works; the matching field map is already prepared for both:
blocker.onReceipt: Step 3 then runs for real: sha256 both files, record dataset IDs, retrieval time, byte size and row count. Step 5 applies the frozen C3 filter and reports rows excluded as moving traffic / bus lane, fallback count, and every unmapped code. Step 6 runs the frozen signal test. No threshold or taxonomy edit after that point.
